  "textEditContent": "# Wekelijkse Poster Website - AI Agent Instructions\n\n## Project Overview\nAn interactive web application for weekly poster distribution with dual interfaces:\n- **Desktop/File Manager UI** (retro terminal-style grid interface)\n- **Mobile AR View** (augmented reality marker detection with A-Frame/AR.js)\n\nCombines PHP backend API, vanilla JavaScript frontend, and WebAR capabilities for responsive poster viewing and admin management.\n\n---\n\n## Architecture Essentials\n\n### Core Stack\n- **Backend**: PHP 7+ (api.php, config.php, security.php)\n- **Frontend**: Vanilla JS (ES6 modules) + A-Frame 1.x + MindAR/AR.js\n- **Data**: JSON-based (ar-settings.json, assets/dpdb.json)\n- **Styling**: CSS Grid + Flexbox (retro terminal aesthetics)\n\n### Key Files &amp; Responsibilities\n\n| File | Purpose |\n|------|---------|\n| **app.js** | Main AR orchestrator: loader system, scene init, target tracking, GIF handling (2800+ lines) |\n| **file-manager.js** | Desktop UI: terminal-style window manager, drag-drop, file browsing (759 lines) |\n| **api.php** | REST endpoints: poster CRUD, auth, AR settings, download tracking |\n| **admin/js/main.js** | Admin panel: authentication, poster upload, layer management |\n| **js/modules/api.js** | Client-side API wrapper (fetchPosters, fetchPoster, fetchARSettings) |\n| **style.css** | All styling: both desktop grid and AR mobile views |\n\n### Data Flow\n1. **Public View**: Browser → app.js → api.php → posters data → file-manager.js renders grid\n2. **AR Detection**: A-Frame scene → targetFound event → Match poster via targetIndex → Show AR layers\n3. **Admin Upload**: Form submission → uploadPoster API → security checks → File system + DB update\n\n---\n\n## Critical Patterns &amp; Conventions\n\n### 1. **Dual-UI Architecture**\n- **Desktop (#desktop-view)**: File manager with grid gallery and sidebar navigation\n- **Mobile (#mobile-ar-view)**: A-Frame AR scene (display: none on desktop, shown on mobile via media query)\n- **Seamless switching**: Same data source, UI context determines what to show\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Pattern: Conditional rendering based on viewport\nconst isDesktop = window.innerWidth &gt; 768;\nif (isDesktop) {\n    document.getElementById('desktop-view').style.display = 'block';\n    document.getElementById('mobile-ar-view').style.display = 'none';\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. **Loader System** (Dutch Localization)\n- Custom hacker-style loader (#hacker-loader) with log queue\n- All UI text translated to Dutch with emoji removal\n- Pattern: &#96;logToLoader('message')&#96; queues logs with random 20-400ms delays\n- Loader hidden after &#96;SYSTEM_READY&#96; message\n\n### 3. **Module Structure**\n- Client modules in &#96;js/modules/&#96;: api.js, ar.js, config.js, ui.js, utils.js\n- Admin modules in &#96;admin/js/modules/&#96;: api.js, config.js, layers.js, ui.js\n- Each module has specific responsibility (no god files)\n- Use ES6 imports: &#96;import { functionName } from './config.js'&#96;\n\n### 4. **API Patterns**\n- **Fetch posters**: GET &#96;/api.php?action=posters&#96; → Array of poster objects with id, title, image, downloads, ar_marker\n- **Auth flow**: POST with password → security.php rate limits &amp; validates → Returns token\n- **AR settings**: GET &#96;/api.php?action=settings&amp;type=ar-tracking&#96; → JSON with filterMinCF, filterBeta, etc.\n- All responses are JSON; errors include message field\n\n### 5. **Window/File Manager System**\n- Windows are Map objects keyed by ID\n- Each window is draggable, resizable, has Z-index management\n- Sidebar filters: \"all\", \"recent\", \"ar\" (AR-enabled posters only)\n- File representation: posters display as files with metadata (title, downloads, ar status)\n\n---\n\n## Security Implementation\n\n### Authentication &amp; Rate Limiting\n- **Rate Limiting**: Max 5 attempts per IP, 15-min lockout (security.php)\n- **Session tokens**: Random tokens stored in sessionStorage (NOT password)\n- **Constant-time password comparison**: Prevents timing attacks\n- **Session timeout**: 1 hour with auto-logout warning at 55 minutes\n- **HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies**: CSRF + XSS protection\n\n### Files to Understand\n- [config.php](config.php): Define &#96;ADMIN_PASSWORD&#96; (must change from 'BETA')\n- [security.php](security.php): &#96;isRateLimited()&#96;, &#96;recordFailedAttempt()&#96;, &#96;validateToken()&#96;\n- [api_utils.php](includes/api_utils.php): Database init, poster CRUD\n- [BEVEILIGING.md](BEVEILIGING.md): Complete security documentation\n\n⚠️ **NEVER**: Expose password in frontend, store tokens in localStorage without HttpOnly, or skip rate limiting checks.\n\n---\n\n## AR System Quirks\n\n### MindAR Integration\n- **Multi-target support**: &#96;.mind&#96; file can contain multiple markers (targetIndex 0, 1, 2...)\n- **Current limitation**: Uses single compiled &#96;.mind&#96; file; dynamic generation not yet implemented\n- **Target matching**: &#96;targetFound&#96; event provides &#96;targetIndex&#96; → match to poster via array position\n- **GIF support**: Custom shader (aframe-gif-shader.js) handles animated GIF playback on AR objects\n\n### AR-Specific Code Patterns\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Typical AR target detection\nscene.addEventListener('targetFound', (event) =&gt; {\n    const targetIndex = event.detail.targetIndex;\n    const poster = window.allPosters[targetIndex];\n    // Show poster info, load GIFs, update UI\n});\n\n// GIF handling (critical for animated AR layers)\nconst gifLoader = new GIFLoader();\ngifLoader.load('path/to/image.gif', (texture) =&gt; {\n    // Update A-Frame material with GIF texture\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Known Issues &amp; TODOs\n- [ ] Dynamically generate &#96;.mind&#96; files on poster upload (currently manual)\n- [ ] Multi-chunk .mind loading (assets/chunks/ exists but not fully integrated)\n- [ ] iOS AR session state management (some WebGL cleanup needed)\n\n---\n\n## Common Tasks &amp; Commands\n\n### Local Development\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start server (port 3000)\nnpm start\n\n# Watch mode (auto-reload)\nnpm run dev\n\n# Admin panel access\nhttp://localhost:3000/admin\n\n# Default admin password: 'BETA' (CHANGE IN config.php!)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### File Structure Conventions\n- **assets/nft/**: Individual poster marker files (.fset, .iset, .fset3)\n- **assets/chunks/**: Compiled chunk manifests for lazy-loading markers\n- **uploads/**: User-uploaded posters (auto-created, include thumbnails/ subfolder)\n- **admin/**: Separate admin panel interface\n- **js/vendor/**: Third-party libraries (aframe.min.js, mindar-image-aframe.prod.js, gif.js)\n\n### Testing AR Features\n1. Generate test marker: Use MindAR compiler on a JPEG poster\n2. Update &#96;ar-settings.json&#96; if tuning filter parameters\n3. Test mobile detection: Media queries use max-width: 768px breakpoint\n4. Debug logs: Check browser console for loader messages (Dutch text)\n\n---\n\n## Before Making Changes\n\n### Check These First\n1. **Is this PHP or JS?** → Backend changes need &#96;api.php&#96;, &#96;security.php&#96;, &#96;config.php&#96; review\n2. **Affects AR?** → Understand MindAR targetIndex system and A-Frame scene structure\n3. **Affects auth?** → Review rate limiting in &#96;security.php&#96; and session handling\n4. **Admin-only?** → Changes likely in &#96;admin/js/main.js&#96; or API endpoint validation\n5. **UI change?** → Consider both desktop (#desktop-view) and mobile (#mobile-ar-view) contexts\n\n### Always Verify\n- ✅ No hardcoded passwords (use config.php &#96;ADMIN_PASSWORD&#96;)\n- ✅ API endpoints exist in api.php (check route parsing)\n- ✅ Dutch text in loader is properly emoji-stripped\n- ✅ AR code uses targetIndex consistently with poster array order\n- ✅ Rate limiting is checked for login attempts (not bypassed)\n- ✅ File paths use relative URLs for cross-domain compatibility\n\n---\n\n## External Dependencies\n\n### Critical Libraries\n- **A-Frame 1.x**: 3D/AR scene framework (js/vendor/aframe.min.js)\n- **MindAR**: Image-based AR tracking (js/vendor/mindar-image-aframe.prod.js)\n- **GIF.js**: GIF parsing &amp; animation (js/vendor/gif.js)\n- **PHP 7+**: Backend requirement (rate limiting, password hashing)\n\n### AR Marker Files\n- Stored in &#96;assets/nft/&#96; (individual markers) or &#96;assets/all-posters.mind&#96; (compiled multi-target)\n- Each poster can have custom &#96;ar_marker&#96; field linking to marker name\n- Generator: Custom Node script in &#96;tools/&#96; (nft-generator) - currently manual process\n\n---\n\n## When Stuck or Debugging\n\n1. **\"Poster not loading\"** → Check api.php routes, ensure posters.json exists\n2. **\"AR not detecting\"** → Verify .mind file, check targetIndex matches poster order, test with known marker\n3. **\"Admin login fails\"** → Check rate limiting (login_attempts.json), verify ADMIN_PASSWORD in config.php\n4. **\"UI not rendering\"** → Check desktop vs mobile detection, confirm element IDs match (#desktop-view, #mobile-ar-view)\n5. **\"GIF not animating\"** → Verify aframe-gif-shader.js loaded, check GIF MIME type is correct\n\n---\n\n**Last Updated**: December 2025 | **Language**: Dutch (UI), English (Code Comments)\n",
